summary: Text-to-speech model designed for natural everyday dialogue, with a web UI, command line and Python API.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: ChatTTS is a generative speech model made for daily dialogue, such as conversations with an AI assistant. This repository has the model's infrastructure and simple examples, including a web UI and a command-line script.
sixtySeconds.problem: Many TTS voices sound flat in conversation. ChatTTS aims for natural, conversational speech you can generate from Python.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a widely used open dialogue-focused TTS with a simple Python API. Community end-user apps are listed in Awesome-ChatTTS.
requirements: Python (3.11 suggested in the conda setup)

overview: Install from PyPI with pip install ChatTTS, or clone the repo and install requirements.txt (optionally in a conda environment with Python 3.11).
From the repo root you can launch the web UI with python examples/web/webui.py, or run python examples/cmd/run.py with your texts to save MP3 files.

In Python, create ChatTTS.Chat(), call load(), then infer() on a list of texts and save the audio at 24000 Hz. The README warns not to install TransformerEngine or FlashAttention-2 for normal use. The code is AGPL-3.0 licensed.
limitations: Some optional speed-ups are not ready
Repo has basic examples, not an end-user app

firstRun.title: Generate speech from the command line (repo root)

tutorial.title: Make speech from Python
tutorial.useCase: Generate audio files from text with the Python API.

steps.title: Write the script
steps.code:
import ChatTTS
import torch
import torchaudio

chat = ChatTTS.Chat()
chat.load(compile=False)

wavs = chat.infer(["PUT YOUR 1st TEXT HERE", "PUT YOUR 2nd TEXT HERE"])

for i in range(len(wavs)):
    torchaudio.save(f"basic_output{i}.wav", torch.from_numpy(wavs[i]).unsqueeze(0), 24000)

steps.body: The first run downloads the model.

troubleshooting.solution: The README notes the save call differs between torchaudio versions; try torch.from_numpy(wavs[i]) without unsqueeze.

troubleshooting.problem: Slow or broken after installing extras
troubleshooting.solution: Don't install TransformerEngine or FlashAttention-2 for normal use.
